meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 让 Claude 对照 Dieter Rams 的十项原则给设计逐项打分(0-3分)并附证据,裁决为“新设计/细化/重设计”,再输出一份 /make-plan 提示。它不写代码,只产出证据、评分、裁决与交接提示。
howto.when: 当你说“audit this design”“design review”“design audit”等短语,或要求按 Rams 原则做设计评审并导出后续计划时;若设计还不存在,直接进入新设计规划。

say.text: 按 Rams 十原则审计当前界面,给出每项分数和证据。
审计这个设计并做出裁决,再给 /make-plan 提示。
对照“好设计”十原则,判断这个 UI 是否需要重做。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude audits the design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scoring each 0–3 with cited evidence, issues a verdict (NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN), and writes a ready-to-run /make-plan prompt. It does not write code; it produces evidence, scorecard, verdict, and handoff.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says phrases like “audit this design”, “design review”, “design audit”, or asks for a Rams-based critique that leads to a plan. If no design exists yet, it skips evidence phases and plans a NEW design.

say_en.text: Audit this UI against Rams' ten principles, give scores and evidence.
Audit this design, issue a verdict, and hand off a /make-plan prompt.
Check this UI against the ten principles — does it need a redesign?
say_en.note: Low total leads to REDESIGN verdict.
